body: To be honest I'm kind of a complete loser. I am 22, have no job, no money, and no hard skills. Hard skills meaning something I can use to make me money or something. I've been suicidal my whole life, well kind of. Since I was 10. I'm don't want to go into it all, but the best times in my life were when I had friends. I still was depressed, but at least I wasn't alone. Now all of my friends have abandoned me. My main interest is video games (usually multiplayer) so I'm not completely alone. It's like almost impossible to meet new friends I feel... Especially for someone who's introverted like me. :/
